reason: The patch adds a stub at pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16 whose RunCommands always fails. On the legacy path, nodes.go:160 calls UnmarshalSQLCommand with no feature-flag check, then NewSQLCommand, then TablesList. So every request logs logger.Error("error serializing sql") with the raw SQL at pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:28, followed by Warn("invalid sql query") with the raw SQL. That Warn is in pkg/expr/sql_command.go:32, not in parser.go as the claim says.
